Thomas Paine, The American Crisis.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-paine/the-american-crisis

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas Paine (annotator, author), died 1809.
- Moncure Daniel Conway (role code edc, writer of introduction), died 1907.
